purpose: Close the natural_proposals_zero diagnosis with one causal high-density EMA direction-state proposal stream, then compare only post-entry exit and inventory policies.

signal_contract.ema_formula: EMA_s,t=alpha_s*mid_close_t+(1-alpha_s)*EMA_s,t-1; alpha_s=2/(s+1); EMA_s is seeded by the arithmetic mean of the first s completed mid closes
signal_contract.direction_formula: LONG when EMA3_t-EMA12_t > 0, SHORT when it is < 0, and carry the most recent nonzero direction on exact equality
signal_contract.exact_zero_tie_break: carry the previous nonzero direction; if the first eligible bar is exactly equal, use LONG
signal_contract.emission_frequency: exactly one RAW_SIGNAL for each eligible completed bar after warmup

chronology.decision: bar open timestamp plus exactly 300 seconds, after the M5 bar is complete
chronology.fill: the next source-record open for that pair at or after the decision timestamp, with source record ordinal strictly later than the decision bar
chronology.max_age_unit: observed completed M5 holding bars, not wall-clock bars
chronology.market_gap: the next observed executable record remains the fill/exit; elapsed wall time remains visible and financing uses it
chronology.terminal: all remaining inventory is forcibly liquidated at the final in-period completed bar executable BID/ASK close

position_contract.currency_exposure_basis: signed fixed-JPY-risk incidence by base and quote currency

policy_candidates.rule: close at next executable open after max_age completed holding bars
at the next signal fill open, close at most one oldest opposite-direction lot before opening the new fixed lot; all remaining lots retain the same finite max age
freeze pair x direction x max_age nearest-rank Q40 of tuning-only executable-side gross MFE; enter with that fixed absolute TP distance and the same finite max age
policy C plus: after a completed close reaches at least half the frozen TP distance, if completed-close progress falls to at most half of its causal peak, close at the next executable open

tp_training.data: only tuning signals whose fill and full candidate max-age observation are both before tuning end
tp_training.statistic: nearest-rank ceil(0.40*n) of executable-side favorable excursion in pips

tp_execution.long_touch: completed bar BID high reaches the frozen absolute target
tp_execution.short_touch: completed bar ASK low reaches the frozen absolute target
tp_execution.fill_price: exact frozen target with no favorable improvement; cost arms are applied after the common exit event
tp_execution.priority: TP touch before giveback or max-age close scheduled from the same completed bar

cost_arms.strict_ordering_required: ADVERSE_STRESS costs are componentwise no easier than EXECUTABLE_BASE and at least one component is strictly worse
cost_arms.fixed_jpy_pnl: notional_jpy * direction * (exit_price-entry_price)/entry_price minus declared costs; short uses the same linear fixed-notional convention

selection_contract.selection_objective: maximize the minimum of BASE and ADVERSE tuning log growth among configurations with positive BASE and ADVERSE mean net expectancy; if none qualify, choose the largest minimum only as a diagnostic comparator

admission_contract.two_x_and_three_x: reported only as final aspirational measurements after freeze and never used for discovery, filtering, tuning, or leverage

execution_contract.restart_policy: output directory must not preexist; a partial output is an explicit failed attempt and is never silently overwritten
